title: Playing with the Claiborne and George Williams band and Nat Towles
summary: He names George Williams's band, the old Claiborne Williams band taken over by his son, and Nat Towles's band in the Middle West; he has been with the Gibson band about a month.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money

blocks.x: Mm-hmm. And do you read music? Mm-hmm. You read music. Can you remember some of the bands that you played with? Or what was the first band you played with? Can you remember?
